isolation_policy: bubblewrap mount namespace: only the workspace, the policy-accepted read allowlist and the opencode runtime exist; the repository, the other arms' results, the earlier sessions and the global opencode configuration (its MCP servers and plugins) are not mounted; plus the opencode v2 permission object (bash denied, edit and write denied, read and external_directory deny-by-default with the explicit allowlist)
limitations: The mount namespace is the filesystem guarantee; the model provider is reachable over the shared network, so a model that was shown a file can still send it away.
sandbox_argv:
Propose exactly one hyperbolic quality METRIC for exported Semantic-ID tables. You are one of 5 independent agents: aim at a different part of the design space than the others, and do not copy an existing metric.
THE OBJECTIVE:
Propose a HYPERBOLIC quality metric for an exported Stage-2 Semantic-ID table that correlates with the Stage-3 test Recall@10 of the run that read it. The metric is a NUMBER computed from the SID table; nothing is trained, no Stage 2 and no Stage 3 run is made, and the metric must be computable in under a minute on 24587 items. It must be judged on 97 SID+recall pairs that already exist.
THE CONTRACT (a proposal that misses it is not evaluated):
A METRIC is IN SCOPE only when all of this holds:
  1. HYPERBOLIC CONSTRUCTION: the number uses an explicit curved operation -- a Poincare or Lorentz distance, exp/log maps, a geodesic or Frechet barycentre in a ball of fixed negative curvature, a tangent-space comparison that is only meaningful because of the map. A Euclidean distance in disguise does not qualify, and the proposal must say where the curvature enters.
  2. COMPUTABLE FROM THE TABLE: the inputs are the exported SID table (the integer code per item and level), optionally the frozen Issue #126 behaviour reference (source/target representations per item, learned on training pairs only) and optionally the TRAINING split. Nothing else.
  3. NO LEAKAGE: no validation interaction and no test interaction may enter the number, directly or through a fitted quantity. A metric that reads the recall, the Stage 3 run, or a validation/test pair is out of scope.
  4. FIXED FORM: no free parameter tuned against the 97 recalls. Any constant must be derived (from the codebook size, the item count, the reference's own temperature) and stated.
  5. ONE NUMBER: the metric returns one scalar per SID table, higher meaning better. Diagnostics that need a second number to interpret are out of scope.
A metric that simply re-expresses the prefix count, the collision rate or the same-bucket ratio is out of scope: those are already measured and the bucket count does not track recall (Spearman -0.065 on the 97 pairs).
WHAT IS ALREADY KNOWN, measured on the 97 pairs (do not repeat these):
  - Q_H (the Issue #126 prefix ranking score, level 1) reaches Spearman +0.634;
  - bucket count reaches -0.065, same-bucket ratio is weak;
  - Q_H at level 2 drops to +0.287 and at level 3 to +0.393, because from level 2 the prefix is nearly an item identifier.
You have no write permission: print your answer in the response itself.
Write PLAIN TEXT, one block, in exactly this shape:
METRIC: <short safe identifier>
TITLE: <one line>
FORMULA: <the mathematics, with every symbol defined; the evaluator implements exactly this>
INPUTS: <the files or arrays it reads, and nothing more>
GEOMETRY: <the curved operation, its curvature, and where it enters>
WHY IT SHOULD TRACK RECALL: <the argument, and what it adds over Q_H>
COMPUTE: <cost on 24587 items and 256 codes>
RISKS: <what could make it fail or be degenerate>
FAILURE MODE: <the SID table on which it must be worst, and why>
END METRIC
WHAT EARLIER METRIC ROUNDS MEASURED on the same 97 pairs:
  - Q_H (Issue #126, level 1): Spearman +0.634, ELIGIBLE; level 2 +0.287, level 3 +0.393;
  - bucket count: -0.065; same-bucket ratio: weak.

The metrics below were implemented to their stated formulas and measured:
  - hyp_voronoi_margin_l1: Spearman -0.081 (p=0.43, CI [-0.285, +0.143]) did NOT track recall
  - hyp_adj_r2_l1: Spearman +0.156 (p=0.13, CI [-0.065, +0.364]) did NOT track recall
  - hbaa: Spearman +0.701 (p=1.3e-15, CI [+0.536, +0.824]) ELIGIBLE
  - hbaa_anchor: Spearman +0.694 (p=3.2e-15, CI [+0.529, +0.819]) ELIGIBLE
  - hbaa_euclid: Spearman +0.693 (p=3.7e-15, CI [+0.524, +0.819]) ELIGIBLE
  - hbaa_flat: Spearman +0.693 (p=3.9e-15, CI [+0.525, +0.818]) ELIGIBLE
  - hbaa_levels: Spearman +0.464 (p=1.7e-06, CI [+0.284, +0.614]) ELIGIBLE
  - hbaa_weighted: Spearman +0.596 (p=1.2e-10, CI [+0.427, +0.730]) ELIGIBLE
  - hbaa_pair_accuracy: Spearman +0.617 (p=1.7e-11, CI [+0.456, +0.741]) ELIGIBLE
  - hyp_hsoftmax_path: Spearman -0.488 (p=3.9e-07, CI [-0.648, -0.289]) did NOT track recall
  - hyp_bucket_reach_lift_l1: Spearman +0.041 (p=0.69, CI [-0.177, +0.256]) did NOT track recall
  - hyp_frechet_cover_radius_l1: Spearman -0.146 (p=0.15, CI [-0.372, +0.078]) did NOT track recall
  - hyp_cell_expected_rank: Spearman +0.300 (p=0.0029, CI [+0.088, +0.501]) ELIGIBLE
  - hyp_cell_rank_lift: Spearman +0.344 (p=0.00056, CI [+0.173, +0.491]) ELIGIBLE
  - MEASURED AND ELIGIBLE, AND NOW THE THING TO BEAT: HBAA, the Gromov common-ancestor alignment of the level-1 prefix with the FULL training history (the hyperbolic barycentre of the history's source representations, Delta = (u_h | mu_b(i+)) - (u_h | mu_b(i-)), reduced with the frozen temperature) reaches Spearman +0.701 on the 97 pairs, against +0.634 for Q_H. Its controls: the same construction with the single anchor +0.694, with Euclidean means and distances +0.693, at curvature 1e-3 +0.693. A one-code table scores 0 and a randomly relabelled table 0.0003, so a collapse is never rewarded.
  - ALSO MEASURED AND FAILED: the normalised geodesic covering radius of the level-1 cells (-0.146), and Q_H extended to levels 1-4 with an informativeness mask, which is Q_H times a weight because from level 2 the prefix centroids collapse onto the items and the level score is 0.
  - WHAT THAT MEANS: every metric of the partition's own geometry fails. The ones that use the frozen reference as a CONTRAST (positive vs negatives) work. To beat +0.634 a proposal must use MORE INFORMATION than a single anchor's source representation and a mean over ten negatives: use the whole training history as the query point (a hyperbolic barycentre of its items), or use the full negative distribution (a temperatured expected rank) instead of its mean, or both. A formula that only rearranges tightness, margin, likelihood or coverage on the same single-anchor inputs is already refuted.
  - WHY the plain path likelihood failed: it correlates with recall at -0.49 but with the number of level-2 buckets at -0.78, and its three highest values in the collection are the 12-code, 2-code and 3-code collapsed tables. It rewards a trie with few branches, i.e. collapse. Any likelihood-like metric must be contrasted against a size-matched null.
Do not restate any of those; propose something whose construction differs from all of them, and say what it adds.

Your answer must be a different metric from the other 4 agents, which you cannot see.
